fields.statement: Verified at b2455268f (attempt 2). Read the diff: newMilestoneNumberProblems now treats as new the milestone intents the plan's change sets created (landed or not) and runs over every plan change set, so a record landed during the interview is still checked, which addresses the confirmed quality/model finding. In a scratch worktree outside ~/code (inside it the root daemon's usage.live.json trips rootguard, unrelated to this change), go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run Milestone passes, including TestRunMilestoneCheckEnforcesNumber: reserved number 7 used passes; wrong handle milestone-8, wrong field milestone=8 and unprefixed done point 'first' each fail naming the intent, 'milestone number 7' and a Fix: line; a misnumbered milestone-8 still fails after the record is proposed, accepted and landed. With run_milestone.go reverted to HEAD~1 that new case fails ('landed record: passed; want a failure'), so the test pins the fix. TestScripts/plan-milestone-number and plan-milestone-check also pass.
